method: Mechanical grouping of SBI purchase rows by verbatim purchaser_name; corporate flag by disclosed substring/word rule (no entity resolution, no JW merges); sorted descending by total_amount_inr; cumulative sum to 99% of corporate total.

corporate_rule.truncated: trailing ' PR' treated as corporate (e.g. FUTURE GAMING AND HOTEL SERVICES PR)
corporate_rule.note: Verbatim names only; variants of the same legal entity (e.g. FUTURE GAMING variants) are listed separately. No Jaro-Winkler merging applied to avoid conflating distinct entities.

limitations: Corporate classification is heuristic and disclosed; borderline names may be misclassified.
No donor->benefit linkage is asserted; benefit data is not in the current sources.
130 expired/unmatched purchase rows are included here (purchase-side totals); linked donation totals (18,741 rows) differ slightly.
